activation_requirement: No clause applies merely because this catalog exists. A fresh recorded human review of the matching original schedule and official invocation/revocation history is required.

rules.clause: Stage III action 8(i), page 14: provide physical and feasible online classes up to V; students/guardians choose online where available. Delhi pilot only; no automatic closure or outdoor ban.

Stage IV action 4(i), pages 16-17: extend feasible hybrid classes to VI-IX and XI, preserving students/guardians' online choice. Stage III primary requirements remain cumulative; X and XII are not added by this clause.

Stage IV Citizen Charter, page 17: children are advised to avoid outdoor activities and stay indoors where possible. HawaHawai adopts indoor alternatives as precaution, not as a legal outdoor ban or school closure.

scope_notes: Mandatory hybrid clauses also name Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar; other NCR areas are discretionary. This MVP implements only NCT Delhi.
Stage IV action 5 allows governments to consider additional measures; it does not automatically close schools. A separate applicable reviewed school order is required.
No stage I/II school closure or blanket outdoor prohibition is manufactured. Separate school orders can still override the general schedule.
Grade zero represents pre-primary for project applicability, not a new official class number.
